evidence.explanation: For this missing-call edge, JS injects random with default rn2 and production create_maze leaves that default intact. This is not a missing draw.
evidence.proof: C dirok[rn2(idx)] and JS directions[random(directions.length)] choose among directions accumulated in the same order. Public level_init maze exercises both constructors and removal. Sixteen full terrain maps match exact C bodies on shared checked draw tapes. No independent RNG algorithm, all-seed or finalization claim.
